title: FP&A Analyst - Treasury
description:
FP&A Analyst - Treasury

Location: Milton Keynes - Hybrid

This role follows a non-negotiable 3-day hybrid working pattern. Candidates must live within a reasonable commuting distance of our Milton Keynes office.

About the Job

We're looking for an analytical and commercially aware FP&A Analyst - Treasury to join our Finance team at Ingram Micro. This is a newly created role that will play a key part in strengthening our cash forecasting, working capital planning and treasury reporting across the UK&I business.

Reporting to the Head of FP&A, you'll take ownership of working capital forecasting and the rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, providing valuable insight into cash performance, funding requirements and forecast accuracy. You'll work closely with finance, operational and commercial teams, as well as Regional and Global Treasury functions, helping to turn complex financial data into clear and actionable recommendations.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with FP&A, treasury or cash flow forecasting experience who enjoys building relationships, improving processes and driving better financial decision-making.

What your role as a FP&A Analyst - Treasury will involve:

• Owning all working capital forecasts, including receivables, payables and inventory across budgets, forecasts and long-term planning cycles

• Preparing, maintaining and delivering the rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, ensuring accurate forecasting of cash receipts and payments

• Producing cash flow and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, KPI reporting and performance insights

• Identifying forecast risks, opportunities and potential cash shortfalls, providing recommendations and escalating issues where required

• Partnering with finance, operational and commercial teams to challenge assumptions and improve forecasting accuracy

• Working closely with Regional and Global Treasury teams to align local forecasting and reporting requirements

• Acting as a key point of contact for financing partners and supporting treasury-related activities

• Developing and enhancing forecasting models, reporting processes and controls to support business growth and decision-making

• Providing scenario analysis, ad hoc financial modelling and treasury support to senior stakeholders

To set you up for success, we are looking for the following skills and experience:

• Experience in FP&A, treasury, cash flow forecasting or working capital management

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills

• Experience producing forecasts, reporting and variance analysis

• Proven analytical and problem-solving ability

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• ACA, ACCA, CIMA, ACT (qualified/part-qualified) or equivalent experience preferred

What we offer:

• AXA Health Insurance and Dental Plan Options - available for you and your family through a salary sacrifice scheme

• Rising holiday allowance at Year 2 and Year 5

• Birthday day off

• Employee Referral Bonus - help us grow our team and get rewarded for introducing great talent.

• Employee discounts and wellness perks

• Modern offices with breakout spaces, free tea and coffee, and a private wellness room

• Development opportunities with clear career progression and training
